skills.name: Passionate Frenzy
skills.description: Unleashes held back emotions and delivers  a frenzy of rapid strikes on enemies.  *ATK per sec x 400% Area Damage (10 sec) *Changes Fire elemental enemies to None (10 sec) *Changes Water elemental enemies to None (10 sec)

skills.name: Noise Canceling
skills.description: Blasts music on headphones to get into the zone.  Good effects on allies.  *Skill Use Rate +40% (10 sec) *Skill Hit Rate +30% (10 sec) *ATK +100% (10 sec)

abilities.name: Group: WIND BREAKER
abilities.description: WIND BREAKER Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle.  You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)
